name: JsonTree
description:
A read-only JSON viewer for tool arguments and results: collapsible objects and arrays,
typed values in the code colours, long arrays paged ("Show 200 more of 1,284") and long
strings cut with the full value on hover.
signature: ({ value, label, truncated, className, }: JsonTreeProps): import("react").JSX.Element

props.name: className
props.description: Classes applied to the outer element for layout. Use the component props and theme tokens for its appearance.

props.name: truncated
props.description: The payload was cut by the server or the client; say so under the tree.

props.name: value
props.description: The controlled value. Keep it in application state and update it in the change callback.
